title: How the Elizabeth Holmes documentary “You Can See Everything” is deceiving
summary: This article critically analyzes how the Netflix documentary 'The Dropout: You Can See Everything' presents a potentially misleading and sympathetic narrative of Elizabeth Holmes and the Theranos scandal, arguing that the documentary oversimplifies the complex fraud case and fails to adequately convey the harm caused to patients and investors.
problem_solved: The article exposes how a popular documentary may be deceiving viewers through selective storytelling and emotional manipulation rather than presenting a balanced account of the Theranos case.
why_valuable: It provides critical media literacy insight into how documentaries can construct misleading narratives around complex fraud cases, helping viewers think more critically about documentary filmmaking.
